new_or_revised.author: Dana Ortiz
new_or_revised.text: Automated reminders cut missed visits from 18% to 10% within six months of launch.

new_or_revised.author: Dana Ortiz
new_or_revised.text: Patients miss mainly because they forget; a 48-hour reminder fixes most of it.

new_or_revised.author: Sam Patel
new_or_revised.text: Most people who missed a visit knew in advance (9 of 12); the barrier is rescheduling, not remembering.
new_or_revised.applies_to: shift and irregular-hours workers (all 12 recruited from evening-clinic list)

new_or_revised.author: Sam Patel
new_or_revised.text: "I knew on Tuesday I couldn't come. The office only answers nine to five."

new_or_revised.author: Sam Patel
new_or_revised.text: 7 of 12 interviewees tried to reschedule after 5 pm; call logs show an evening spike in abandoned calls.
